items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: the next name I worked with was Roy Eldridge and Sonny Stitt.

ctx.x: And then somebody around the corner told Stuff Smith he needed a bass player; he was going to a club out at North Side. And so I worked for Stuff for 2 weeks. Then after Stuff, the next name I worked with was Roy Eldridge and Sonny Stitt.
Sonny Stitt was in the band?

Yeah, well, see, Roy come to Chicago looking for a band, and he knew Stitt was hanging around, because I think that's where Eckstein's band broke up was in Chicago; in fact, they did break up in Chicago. They played the Regal Theatre and that was the end of it. But Stitt was around then, and he told me one night, it was at a little after hours place, all the musicians used to come and jam,
